title: lecanthus major
intro: Lecanthus major, commonly known as Hyptis suaveolens, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues, fever, and skin problems, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Lecanthus major include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its healing effects. The bioactive constituents of Lecanthus major include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
